author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00022801 and ARBA00022487

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel FBgn0051146 / Nlg1 (Q9VIC7)

* **Description of issue**
Q9VIC7 gets these two 2-step annotations:
ARBA00022801 -> KW #Hydrolase, KW-0378 -> GO:0016787 hydrolase activity
ARBA00022487 -> KW #Serine esterase, KW-0719 -> GO:0052689 carboxylic ester hydrolase activity

ARBA00022801 seems to be because of this match:
InterPro signature [IPR019826](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR019826) Carboxylesterase type B, active site
InterPro signature [IPR029058](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR029058) Alpha/Beta hydrolase fold

ARBA00022487 seems to be because of this match:
InterPro signature [IPR019826](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR019826)
taxon [Ecdysozoa](https://www.uniprot.org/taxonomy/1206794)

But Nlg1 is a Neuroligin, which are known to be similar to acetylcholinesterase, but characterized as lacking catalytic activity.
Moreveover, none of the InterPro signatures cited above have any catalytic GO annotations.
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00022801 and ARBA00022487
